competitorWins: ConflictZone is genuinely stronger for focused conflict analysis: AI-generated weekly intel briefs, per-conflict severity ratings and trajectory analysis, conflict timelines, and free email escalation alerts with no account required. For someone who only wants to follow specific conflicts, its structured dossiers are more convenient than WorldEye's broader intel feeds.
description: ConflictZone (conflictzone.io) is an AI-powered conflict-tracking site that monitors 65+ conflicts with per-conflict pages, live maps, conflict timelines, severity ratings (e.g., HIGH), key actors, AI intel briefs, and escalation alerts — its Mexico cartel page notes live news from verified sources updated every 5 minutes. It differs from WorldEye by being a dedicated conflict-analysis site (free account with weekly AI briefs and email alerts, no credit card) rather than a free general live-planet globe with cameras, flights, ships, weather, and quakes.

tagline: AI-powered conflict tracker covering 65+ conflicts with live maps, severity ratings, and escalation alerts.
verdictCompetitor: Choose ConflictZone if you want structured AI-written briefs, severity ratings, and free escalation alerts for specific conflicts you're following.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want a free, no-signup live planet globe — cameras, flights, ships, weather, quakes — with conflict intel as one Pro layer, plus an AI assistant and OSINT toolkit from $3.99/week.
whyWorldEye: WorldEye's map is free with no signup at all — ConflictZone gates its AI briefs and saved conflicts behind a free account.
One free globe combines ~76,000 live cameras with live flights, ships, satellites, weather, earthquakes, and wildfires — ConflictZone covers conflicts only.
Pro starts at $3.99/week: AI analyst assistant, OSINT recon toolkit (Nmap, DNS, WHOIS, SSL), premium cyber/GDELT/maritime/conflict intel feeds, and high-res satellite imagery.
Free live aircraft and maritime tracking that ConflictZone does not offer.
Interactive 3D globe with global search and advanced filters for exploring anything, not just conflict pages.
Use WorldEye's Pro conflict feeds alongside ConflictZone's AI briefs for a richer situational picture.
